use: Portals with events the user must see: new documents, decisions.
avoid: Confirmation of an action: use Toast.
anatomy: Panel: header with "Mark all as read", items (slot), footer with a link.
Item: avatar or icon, title, text, time, unread dot.
reactProps: NotificationMenu count, onMarkAllRead, footer, empty, children
NotificationItem title, children, time, unread, avatar, href / onClick
behaviour: Clicking the bell opens the panel. Escape or a click outside closes it and moves focus back.
Clicking a notification opens the subject and marks it as read.
a11y: The count is part of the button name. The badge is aria-hidden.
content: Title = who or what. Text = what happened.
dont: Mark notifications as read automatically when the panel opens.
name: Notifications
summary: Notifications in the header: a bell with the number of unread items, a panel with notifications, "Mark all as read" and a link to all notifications.
